claim_boundary: This document is an open preregistration/audit ledger. It authorizes no product PASS and no Knight execution.

verified_findings.finding: Fixed tile_resolution=8 was selected from atlas capacity, not source-frequency or projected-texel-density preservation.
verified_findings.required_closure: Subject-free projected footprint / high-frequency line-art survival calibration; select fixed/adaptive tile policy from art-quality evidence.
verified_findings.repair: Tile resolution is now resolved from the worst visible source-projection barycentric singular scale under an explicit <=1 source-pixel/atlas-texel limit and atlas-capacity gate; fixed tile=8 is no longer authority.

verified_findings.finding: COMPILED_NEAREST_SURFACE and COMPILED_GLOBAL_SURFACE are cKDTree nearest-sample color propagation, not structure-aware inpainting.
verified_findings.required_closure: Replace shipping completion with source-constrained surface completion for bounded gaps; forbid visible global fill; fail/abstain on unsupported large regions.
verified_findings.repair: Global/Euclidean nearest propagation was replaced by component-bounded canonical-surface harmonic completion with a frozen 16-sample/2-hop region cap and fail-closed no-boundary behavior.

verified_findings.finding: The same canonical surface locus can be directly observed in multiple views without an explicit cross-view appearance compatibility authority.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add adjacent-view/component alpha contradiction and source-conditioned premultiplied color/edge compatibility evidence without requiring naive RGB equality.
verified_findings.repair: Stage24 now computes adjacent-view same-canonical compatibility per pair and per component and includes the frozen compatibility predicate in shipping PASS.

verified_findings.finding: Historical Stage45 exempted micro-visible faces and consequential-but-unmeasurable faces from the shipping condition and aggregated inferred exposure globally.
verified_findings.required_closure: Hard-gate unmeasurable consequential faces, micro-face pixel load, frame-max exposure, largest connected inferred patch and visible global-fill exposure.
verified_findings.repair: Stage45 now hard-gates frame-max and connected compiled-unobserved exposure, micro-visible pixel load, consequential-but-unmeasurable face count, and forbids undefined/global-fill visibility. The visibility-load gate has direct negative controls for micro-mass and unmeasurable consequential faces.

verified_findings.finding: Native CAA runtime uses premultiplied bilinear sampling only; no mip/minification or anisotropic sampling authority exists.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add subject-free screen-space minification/shimmer controls and a qualified filtering/LOD contract shared by reference and native runtimes.
verified_findings.repair: Until mip/aniso exists, rest and dynamic proofs now hard-reject any contributing face whose screen-to-atlas Jacobian exceeds 1 texel per output pixel in any principal direction.

verified_findings.finding: CAA is baked on Stage18 candidate identity while final Stage35 QualifiedMesh only carried the candidate hash transitively; Stage37/38 lacked explicit equality enforcement.
verified_findings.repair: Stage37/38 require CompleteAppearanceAsset.candidate_mesh_binding_hash == QualifiedMesh.metadata.source_candidate_lineage_hash; test_v2_tail_authority_fail_closed.py directly attacks candidate-binding mismatch.

verified_findings.finding: PRESERVE_CONTINUITY historically required only global connected-component membership and did not prove local boundary adjacency.
verified_findings.repair: Qualified mesh intrinsic audit requires a shared-support vertex or direct mesh edge for every PRESERVE_CONTINUITY relation; test_product_authority_v1.py contains a globally-connected-but-locally-disconnected adversary that must fail with QUALIFIED_MESH_G4_PRESERVE_LOCAL_ADJACENCY_MISSING.

verified_findings.finding: Rigid/deformable classification was computed once per mechanical component, so appearance-separated presentation groups inherited one class and rigid props inside deformable components could silently wobble.
verified_findings.repair: Mechanical classification is now evaluated per presentation face group.

verified_findings.finding: V2 exact-depth ties are resolved by sealed face index and no near-depth ambiguity/z-fighting gate exists. Determinism therefore does not guarantee artist-authoritative layer order or temporal stability.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add exact/near-depth overlap ambiguity evidence and either fail ambiguous physical-depth states or mint an explicit qualified presentation tie authority with a narrowly scoped contract.
verified_findings.repair: The hidden depth comparator epsilon is now explicit authority: VISIBILITY_DEPTH_EQUIVALENCE_EPSILON=1e-12 camera-Z with IEEE754_FLOAT64_SOFTWARE_SORT and no hardware-Z quantization. Depth deltas inside/equal to epsilon remain ambiguity evidence and are hard-failed by the existing zero exact-depth budget; deltas outside epsilon are ordered by canonical physical depth. Subject-free controls bracket 0.5x versus +/-2x epsilon, and RSS V2 seals both the float64 depth-buffer contract and epsilon; native tamper adversaries reject either contract being changed. Independent artist-authored draw order remains outside first-witness scope under VF-20 rather than being smuggled in as an arbitrary near-depth threshold.

verified_findings.finding: No explicit adjacent-direction appearance continuity or direction-switch flicker authority exists for the eight separately baked CAA textures.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add source-conditioned adjacent-direction compatibility plus transition/shimmer controls; do not demand raw RGB equality where view-dependent artist intent is supported.

verified_findings.finding: The 256-cube decoder numerical floor is demonstrated primarily on smooth sphere/ellipsoid controls; minimum thin-feature/concavity/gap survival through decoder->raster is not explicitly calibrated.
verified_findings.required_closure: Run a 1024px subject-free feature-survival panel (thin plates/straps, narrow gaps/forks, concave notches, brims/blades, small components) and derive decoder/adaptive-resolution policy from measured survival.
verified_findings.repair: A 1024px subject-free five-family feature-survival panel (20 physical cases, 160 view measurements) falsified the smooth-control-only interpretation of a general R256 decoder numerical floor. At R256, 0.75/1.0-reference-voxel straps do not bracket zero; narrow fork/notch negative space collapses; detached small components can have 0% component recall while aggregate silhouette recall remains ~0.994; thin blades remain below the frozen Stage13 profile. canonical/VF11_GEOMETRY_FEATURE_SURVIVAL_CALIBRATION_V1_20260921.json seals the negative result. The IRIS V3 signed field is arbitrary-P queryable, so the next authorized experiment holds physical feature widths fixed and re-queries the same continuous field at R384. Frozen Stage13 P999 thresholds are reused without relaxation.

verified_findings.finding: Hash invalidation forces downstream remeasurement after an upstream repair, but no explicit dual-domain non-regression rule prevents a rest improvement from consuming dynamic quality margin or vice versa.
verified_findings.required_closure: Require every geometry/appearance repair candidate to pass both static and dynamic adversarial banks before promotion, with protected-metric non-regression evidence.
verified_findings.repair: The bounded repair service now marks every current directive as requiring V2 static+dynamic visual non-regression. Repair effect credit requires evidence bound to the exact child product hash, non-empty static/dynamic bank hashes, PASS for both banks, and one identical implementation-closure hash across the two banks. Missing evidence, dynamic regression, child drift or cross-bank implementation drift rejects the repair.

verified_findings.finding: Rigid thresholds 0.999/0.001 can silently classify evidence-supported rigid groups as DEFORMABLE; there is no calibrated rigid-detection coverage/no-op proof.
verified_findings.required_closure: Calibrate group-level rigid/deformable decisions on subject-free hard-rigid and smooth-skin controls and expose evidence-supported rigid misses as failures.

verified_findings.finding: Current dynamic appearance calibration contains affine stretch controls but no articulated LBS shoulder/elbow/hip bend cases; absolute UV-to-surface condition ceiling 32 is outside the selected relative candidate ladder.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add subject-free articulated LBS benign/adversarial controls and calibrate every shipping conditioning ceiling from that bank before refreeze.
verified_findings.repair: Dynamic appearance thresholds are bound to a subject-free articulated LBS hinge bank in addition to affine controls; Knight is not used for threshold selection.

verified_findings.finding: Stage45 cannot treat arbitrary owner=-1 dynamic background as a crack because legitimate articulation may create new negative space. The real false-PASS class is an owner=-1 gap that violates an authority-backed continuity relation (for example an interior mesh adjacency or another explicitly non-detachable continuity contract). Current Stage17/37 evidence proves same-mesh shared-edge continuity, but does not yet mint a general cross-component dynamic continuity/underlay authority.
verified_findings.required_closure: Do not gate raw dynamic background area. Bind crack qualification only to explicit continuity authority: prove no raster gap across topologically interior/shared continuity edges, and define a separate source-backed underlay/non-detachability contract before judging gaps between mechanically separate components. Add adversarial synthetic controls for both a true seam crack and legitimate new negative space.
verified_findings.repair: Stage45 now evaluates only topology-owned interior shared-edge continuity. For every frame/view, all incident face copies of a canonical shared edge must use bit-exact equal projected endpoints from the single posed vertex matrix; any mismatch hard-fails dynamic visual integrity. Subject-free adversaries detect a 0.25 px true seam crack, while topologically separate faces with large negative space are explicitly not classified as cracks. The product HALF_INTEGER_TOP_LEFT rasterizer is separately controlled to tile two triangles across a shared diagonal without an uncovered pixel. Stage46 requires this continuity proof and forbids cross-component background-gap crack authority.

verified_findings.finding: A future mip/minification repair cannot reuse the current two-pixel per-tile bleed blindly; ordinary atlas mip generation can mix neighboring face tiles across mip levels even when base-level bilinear bleed is correct.
verified_findings.required_closure: Qualify mip-safe island padding or per-island/per-face mip generation together with the minification filter contract.
verified_findings.repair: Current V2 explicitly authorizes only BASE_LEVEL_BILINEAR_LINEAR_PM_ONLY and forbids mip generation/consumption. Combined with the <=1 texel/output-pixel minification gate, mip bleed is outside the current shipping capability rather than silently unsupported. Native consumer rejects tampered mip or alternate-sampler contracts.

verified_findings.finding: Stage41 bounds triangle area ratio and local condition but has no explicit non-adjacent dynamic self-intersection/interpenetration qualification. A mesh can remain locally well-conditioned while distinct body/clothing regions pass through each other and corrupt visibility.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add subject-free dynamic self-intersection evidence with adjacency exclusions and rest-existing-contact handling; gate newly introduced consequential intersections or explicitly narrow the product claim.
verified_findings.repair: Stage41 now rejects newly introduced unexpected intersections and also measures rigid-transform-invariant homothetic intersection-persistence severity for every rest-existing unexpected pair. Posed severity may not exceed rest severity beyond the deterministic 24-step binary-search numerical slack. Direct controls require rigid-transform invariance and strictly greater severity for deeper overlap.

verified_findings.finding: Current contact mode set contains only PLANT_2D and Stage41 correctly measures XY drift. This is not a contract bug, but it cannot establish full foot-ground height/penetration or 3D pinned-contact quality despite broad all_contacts_satisfied wording.
verified_findings.required_closure: Narrow the claim to PLANT_2D or add calibrated PLANT_3D / ground-plane contact semantics with vertical height and penetration evidence before professional-contact quality is claimed.
verified_findings.repair: Current V2 authority is explicitly narrowed to declared PLANT_2D contact only: the Stage41 report exposes all_declared_plant_2d_contacts_satisfied, supported_contact_modes=[PLANT_2D], and full_3d_ground_contact_quality_claimed=false. The historical broad all_contacts_satisfied field exists only in the non-current V1 implementation and is forbidden from the V2 qualification report by integration test.

verified_findings.finding: Native V2 proof renders only exact sealed Stage41 frame indices. No current evidence was found that native proof interpolates unproved frames; however host-side continuous interpolation semantics are not explicit in the V2 package authority.
verified_findings.required_closure: Declare playback sampling semantics explicitly. If hosts interpolate, prove the interpolation envelope; otherwise require exact sealed-frame playback semantics.
verified_findings.repair: Runtime package seals SEALED_FRAME_INDEX_ONLY with host_interpolation_authorized=0; native consumer enforces both and parses frame/view integers lexically exact so fractional strings cannot truncate through std::stoi. Native adversaries reject fractional frame requests and interpolation-enabled package tampering.

verified_findings.finding: Stage37 previously claimed UI draw order and clipping while current V2 runtime package serializes one full mesh + CAA + posed XYZ and does not execute slot/attachment tint/order/visibility/clipping state. Presentation structure is currently authoring evidence, not runtime keyability proof.
verified_findings.repair: First-witness V2 keeps presentation structure as authoring evidence only. MAINLINE Stage37 explicitly sets runtime_slot_state_execution_claimed=false, runtime_clipping_claimed=false and runtime_tint_order_visibility_claimed=false. The RSS V2 manifest now seals presentation_state_execution_authorized=0, clipping_authorized=0 and tint_order_visibility_authorized=0; the native consumer rejects any tampered package that enables one of those unsupported capabilities.
verified_findings.required_closure: Either implement and native-prove runtime presentation state transitions (attachment/visibility/order/tint/clipping as required by product scope) or keep those capabilities explicitly outside the first-witness claim.

verified_findings.finding: Python and native V2 CAA samplers treat encoded RGBA8 RGB as linear values: RGB is divided by 255, premultiplied by alpha and bilinearly filtered without an explicit sRGB/linear transfer function. Native/reference byte parity can therefore certify identical gamma-space filtering rather than source-faithful color filtering.
verified_findings.required_closure: Make the texture color-space contract explicit and shared by compile/reference/native runtime. Calibrate subject-free opaque gradients, dark/light edges and semi-transparent anti-aliased line-art controls; qualify linear-light premultiplied filtering or explicitly prove an alternative artist-preserving encoded-space contract.
verified_findings.repair: Compile/reference/native now share explicit sRGB transfer functions and linear-light premultiplied filtering/compositing. Native smoke now includes a black/white midpoint discriminator that must encode linear 0.5 near sRGB 188, not gamma-space 128.

verified_findings.finding: Stage42 casts canonical mesh positions, every Stage41 posed vertex frame and face UVs to float32 before packaging. Stage45 reference rendering consumes the same quantized arrays, so native/reference parity cannot detect Stage41->runtime quantization drift in screen ownership, thin features, near-depth ordering or UV sampling.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add an explicit Stage41-double -> packaged-float32 projection/ownership/RGBA non-regression proof on subject-free thin-feature, near-depth and subpixel controls; select package precision from evidence or retain higher precision where needed.
verified_findings.repair: Stage41 posed XYZ/runtime projection/CAA face UV authority are now preserved as float64 through compile, bake NPZ and runtime package transport rather than being born or cast to float32 before proof.

verified_findings.finding: The principal Stage37-46 integration fixture overrides multiple production appearance/DVI thresholds to permissive values for its tiny synthetic asset. Unit tests exercise individual production policy fields, but the exact production policy is not yet proven feasible end-to-end on a representative subject-free art/geometry/motion control.
verified_findings.required_closure: Create a representative subject-free end-to-end control bank that runs the unmodified production geometry/CAA/DVI policies, including thin line art, alpha edges, occlusion completion, articulated motion, near-depth overlap and rigid/deformable presentation groups. No fixture-only threshold relaxation may count as product readiness.

verified_findings.owner: Runtime raster coverage / temporal edge quality
verified_findings.finding: Reference and native V2 visibility use one binary pixel-center triangle coverage sample. CAA alpha is applied only after geometry ownership, so subpixel silhouette coverage has no MSAA/analytic coverage authority. Native/reference parity can therefore certify identical edge popping/jaggies during motion.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add subject-free moving thin-edge/subpixel-silhouette temporal controls and qualify a coverage/AA contract (analytic coverage, supersampling/MSAA-equivalent or another deterministic scheme) shared by reference/native runtime. Gate temporal edge shimmer independently from texture minification.
verified_findings.repair: Runtime V2 now uses a sealed fixed 2x2 quarter-subsample coverage contract. Each coverage sample receives its own K=4 geometry depth stack and linear-premultiplied front-to-back composite; the four sample PM results are averaged before straight-sRGB8 export. Provenance is conservative across all contributing samples. Stage45 no longer treats the single debug owner as full-pixel authority: front/contributor census is computed from the exact four coverage samples and all sample x K4 contributors. Native playback enforces the coverage manifest, rejects coverage-count tampering, and is byte-parity checked against the Python reference for RGBA, provenance and representative owner. A subject-free edge adversary requires fractional 1/4, 1/2 or 3/4 coverage alpha. Self-hosted runtime run 35572727905 passed on functional commit 8484a1071cfae7ea539c43e53b6d3ed51ae2da2e.

verified_findings.finding: Source sampling correctly premultiplies before bilinear interpolation, but immediately unpremultiplies and quantizes every compiled surface sample back to straight RGBA8. Those straight u8 samples are later baked and premultiplied again at runtime. Low-alpha anti-aliased texels can therefore lose premultiplied color precision even though metadata describes the internal alpha contract as PREMULTIPLIED.
verified_findings.required_closure: Audit the real alpha representation at every compile/bake/package boundary. Add low-alpha anti-aliased dark/light edge controls, quantify PM round-trip error, and either keep sufficient premultiplied precision through the internal CAA asset or prove that the chosen transport quantization is visually lossless under the product gate.
verified_findings.repair: Stage24 gates actual pre-quantization bilinear linear-PM samples against post-straight-RGBA8 roundtrip error. The subject-free calibration test now spans high-contrast and low-alpha bilinear intermediate values rather than only exactly representable source texels.

verified_findings.finding: Current source/holdout/seam quality relies heavily on mean and p95 premultiplied RGBA errors. A sparse but visually salient feature occupying less than the upper 5% of samples (eye line, brim edge, blade edge, thin highlight) can be catastrophically lost while aggregate mean/p95 remain acceptable.
verified_findings.required_closure: Add topology/feature-aware visual fidelity evidence: connected high-error region bounds, thin-line/edge recall, high-contrast feature survival and per-component salient-feature controls. Tightening p95 alone is insufficient.
verified_findings.repair: Rest proof now includes p99.9 error, connected high-error-island bounds, and 1px source-feature edge recall/precision; a one-pixel line-loss adversary is required to fail despite <5% affected area.

verified_findings.finding: Adjacent-view shared-canonical source compatibility is now measured and hash-bound in Stage24 metadata, but qualification explicitly records cross_view_source_compatibility_shipping_gate_frozen=false and the cross-view metrics are absent from the Stage24 passed predicate.
verified_findings.required_closure: Calibrate subject-free compatible vs contradictory adjacent-view controls, freeze per-pair/per-component alpha/color/edge conflict bounds and make cross-view compatibility a hard Stage24 gate without requiring naive raw-RGB equality.
verified_findings.repair: cross_view_source_compatibility_shipping_gate_frozen is now true and pair/component compatibility is part of the Stage24 passed predicate under frozen subject-free thresholds.

verified_findings.finding: Current V2 reference/native runtime resolves exactly one front geometry owner per pixel and samples/composes only that face. Texture alpha is correctly forbidden from selecting the front surface, but there is no depth peeling or ordered multi-surface alpha compositing. A transparent or semi-transparent front face can therefore suppress valid deeper character geometry and appear as a background hole rather than revealing the next surface/layer.
verified_findings.required_closure: Define the product transparency/layer contract. For any supported overlapping transparent art, render and native-prove ordered multi-surface compositing (depth peeling / qualified presentation layer stack or equivalent) with premultiplied alpha. If first witness forbids overlapping transparent surfaces, qualify that restriction explicitly and reject assets that violate it rather than silently rendering holes.
verified_findings.repair: Reference/native use a depth-sorted K=4 geometry surface stack with deterministic linear-PM front-to-back composition and hard overflow rejection. Stage45 now exposes and conditions all layers that actually contribute alpha/color, not only layer-0 owner.

verified_findings.finding: Reference and native V2 rasterizers accept both triangle orientations; no qualified front-only/two-sided presentation-surface contract exists. Under motion a face can become back-facing yet still render the same CAA texture, producing mirrored/inside-out art without violating current intrinsic conditioning or native parity.
verified_findings.required_closure: Mint explicit per-presentation-group sidedness semantics from qualified geometry/presentation evidence. Gate newly visible unsupported backfaces, or provide separately qualified back-side appearance where two-sided rendering is intended. Add articulated flip/backface adversarial controls.
verified_findings.repair: Stage45 gates newly visible projected orientation reversal relative to the qualified rest face with a zero-count policy. The signed-area helper has direct inside-out and subpixel-degenerate adversaries. Two-sided/back-side presentation remains unsupported rather than silently rendered.

verified_findings.finding: After K=4 alpha compositing was implemented, Stage45 still derived consequential-face conditioning from native layer-0 owner.raw only. A transparent front face could therefore reveal a deeper visually dominant surface whose stretch/orientation was omitted from DVI.
verified_findings.repair: Reference rendering now exposes per-layer contribution masks and layer owner identities. Stage45 unions front geometry with all actual visual contributors for consequential-face, micro-load, conditioning and orientation qualification.

verified_findings.finding: current-runtime-self-hosted-ci executed the V2 native smoke and fail-closed tail tests but its push path filter did not include those test files. Native proof authority could therefore be edited without triggering the runtime gate on that exact commit.
verified_findings.repair: The runtime workflow push filter now includes tests/compiler/test_runtime_v2_native_smoke.py and tests/compiler/test_v2_tail_authority_fail_closed.py. The native smoke also contains a linear-light discriminator.

verified_findings.finding: The current runtime workflow was path-filtered on compiler core/export/proof and native runtime sources, but not on the V2 appearance/runtime orchestrator adapters that implement Stage23-25 and Stage42-45 product qualification. Shipping-gate logic could therefore change on main without triggering the exact native/runtime proof workflow.
verified_findings.repair: current-runtime-self-hosted-ci now triggers on compiler/realsas_compiler_services/orchestrator/adapters/runtime_v2.py and appearance_v2.py so Stage23-25/42-45 authority changes are checked on the exact promoted SHA.

verified_findings.finding: The subject-free CAA policy, layered visibility, and dynamic appearance conditioning adversarial suites existed in the repository but were not executed by any current workflow. A main commit could therefore retain green current CI while violating repaired visual-fidelity invariants.
verified_findings.repair: current-runtime-self-hosted-ci now runs test_caa_v2_subject_free_policy.py, test_visibility_and_caa_v2.py, and test_dynamic_appearance_conditioning_v2.py as a mandatory V2 visual-fidelity red-team bank on the same SHA as native parity.

verified_findings.finding: The runtime/native workflow did not trigger when the canonical V2 appearance numerical policy or dynamic-appearance calibration authority changed. Shipping limits could therefore be relaxed without forcing the implementation and adversarial banks to rerun.
verified_findings.repair: current-runtime-self-hosted-ci now triggers on CAA_V2_SUBJECT_FREE_NUMERICAL_POLICY_20260920.json and DYNAMIC_APPEARANCE_CONDITIONING_CALIBRATION_V1_20260921.json, binding policy changes to the exact runtime/native/red-team gate.

verified_findings.finding: The native runtime source-gate push paths did not include the verifier script itself or the new extension seal, and the pull-request path set omitted older extension seals V3/V4. In addition, subtree-set drift had hidden three changed sealed blobs plus two unsealed runtime blobs behind the first failure.
verified_findings.repair: Append-only source extension V5 seals the exact current 25-file runtime/realsas_cpp subtree (3 replacements, 2 additions) without mutating historical seals. The verifier consumes V5 as closure authority, and push/PR triggers now include the verifier plus the full extension chain V1-V5.

false_or_overstated_external_findings.claim: G5 calibration PASS hides current_mesh_semantic_separation_pass=false as an active failed shipping metric.
false_or_overstated_external_findings.reason: Those booleans belong to a retrospective corruption-separation audit showing older/current thresholds failed to separate controls; the selected P999 profile is the promoted policy. The remaining valid concern is insufficient feature-rich numerical-floor calibration.

false_or_overstated_external_findings.claim: 256-cube implies exactly four source pixels per voxel at 1024.
false_or_overstated_external_findings.reason: Projected pixel scale depends on normalized bounds, object occupancy and camera framing. A fixed 256 decoder can still impose a feature ceiling, but it must be measured rather than inferred as a universal 4px/voxel ratio.

requirements: Every HIGH finding CLOSED with executable subject-free evidence.
Every repaired invariant has an adversarial regression test.
Static and dynamic fidelity banks both PASS on the same exact implementation closure.
No threshold is selected or relaxed from Knight.
Fresh stage-by-stage red-team finds no unscoped product-quality false-PASS.
Assistant and user explicitly approve before Knight.
